settings.point_three_body: All 32 pins and four regional display boxes are included.

settings.decision_title: The close-ups are part of a much bigger collection.
settings.decision_body: You receive eight badges each from Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh—not just the designs featured in the detail shots.
settings.final_title: Get a closer look at your own set.
settings.final_body: All 32 enamel badges and four display boxes. Free U.S. shipping; typically arrives in 5–7 business days.
